subject_field_counts.interpretation: Counts are field values, not unique token occurrences. Slash-bearing includes selectors and slash-delimited kind paths, so it is not a count of narrowing operators. All selected Subject values containing <+ begin in a CAPRMEDIO namespace chain; none contains +>. Do not treat namespace separators as composition Relation aliases.

fresh_current_cfel_snapshot.ambiguity: Literal counts scan each preserved raw block. fresh_current_cfel_snapshot.workflow_workbench_boundary: Only the pinned 1,167 supplier paths were extracted; no actual Workflow or Workbench instance/source mutation occurred.

migration_classes.mapping: Current '/' spelling for NARROWER_THAN maps to the accepted '//' narrowing spelling.
migration_classes.authority: CA-R-2475@5 Current; the named-instance decision reserves '//' for narrowing and rejects it as named-instance syntax.
migration_classes.gate: Apply only to a parsed kind-narrowing expression or the NARROWER_THAN alias declaration. A single slash inside Atom property qualifiers, compound type paths, quoted Scope Unit path data, filenames, or prose is not mechanically equivalent.

migration_classes.mapping: For a named Relation, use the approved typed address form, e.g. Relation//IS_PROPERTY_OF -> $x[<Relation>, .Name = IS_PROPERTY_OF]. Generalized kind/name references still require a unique current Name target and a syntactic position that admits the typed selector.
migration_classes.counts: 96 Subject field values contain Relation// named targets; additional Scope Unit// values are separately counted.
migration_classes.gate: Do not rewrite static identities as narrowing. Do not invent anonymous-filter syntax; every such rewrite must bind a named variable as in the approved example.

migration_classes.mapping: Existing Atom/(.Header.Role: Value)//$x forms are typed, named binders, not anonymous selectors. Successor form must retain the same Atom kind, all admitted conditions, and binding scope. Apply the approved colon/value/selector distinctions at each condition; do not erase a condition or change its operator by text replacement.
migration_classes.counts: 605 Subject values contain Atom/ selectors (154 active and 451 passive).
migration_classes.gate: Review conditions and bound-variable scope from the source CFEL block. Do not convert an unbound selector to a set-valued anonymous filter.

migration_classes.mapping: Current CFEL aliases are relation-level: IS_CONTAINED_BY uses +> and derived inverse CONTAINS uses <+. A replacement path spelling must preserve which endpoint is the contained object and which is the immediate Container; it must not duplicate or reverse the stored relation fact.
migration_classes.authority: CA-R-2478@5; CA-R-2617@2; existing scanner reports 49 IS_CONTAINED_BY and 5 CONTAINS uses on the prior selected frontier.
migration_classes.gate: Do not replace every '<+' string: in selected Subject values it is a CAPRMEDIO namespace separator. Coordinate relation alias declarations and CFEL use sites only after exact endpoint direction is established.

migration_classes.authority: CA-R-2530@2 current Subject CAPRMEDIO_MODEL <+ Scope Unit.Path.
migration_classes.finding: The illustrative '/~ENGINE/PROGRAMMATIC' form is absent from all active/passive fields in the 1,167 snapshot and is not an admitted alias. A full Scope Unit path string uses actual Scope Unit names; slash characters inside the stored string are data and must not be rewritten as CFEL traversal syntax.
migration_classes.gate: Keep path serialization and expression operator parsing separate; resolve path components against current Scope Unit declarations.

pinned_examples.migration_note: One carrier combines a typed named Relation target with a compound narrowing/composition path; it cannot be rewritten as one uniform slash substitution.
Direct named Relation instance address; candidate typed selector must bind the same declared Relation name.
The Relation instance target needs the typed named-address form; its '/'-alias semantics separately need migration to the accepted narrowing '//' token.
The aliases express direct containment with part-to-container endpoint direction; path rendering must preserve that orientation and direct storage.
A static Scope Unit identity, not a narrowing path or a file path. Resolve the unique declared Name before typed-address migration.
Current authority for a Scope Unit path value; path-value representation is separate from '/', '//', and relation aliases in CFEL expressions.

recommended_next_action: Make the migration inventory syntax-aware by category: (1) rewrite declared NARROWER_THAN alias and parsed kind-narrowing contexts from '/' to '//'; (2) replace static named-instance addresses with the explicitly accepted named typed selector, preserving unique kind/name identity; (3) convert Atom qualified binders only with conditions and binding scope preserved; (4) treat +>/<+ as relation-alias migrations with endpoint checks and preserve CAPRMEDIO namespace <+ chains; (5) leave quoted Scope Unit path strings as data. Refresh CFEL coverage to the 1,167 snapshot before claiming an exhaustive block count; retain actual Workflow/Workbench exclusions.
